يعتمرون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَمِرُونَ (yaʕtamirūna) /jaʕ.ta.mi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# يُعْتَمَرُونَ (yuʕtamarūna) /juʕ.ta.ma.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
